items.text: Website design and development for small businesses — modern, fast, mobile-friendly sites in one language or several, with ongoing support.

items.name: SEO
items.text: Get found on Google. Keyword research, clear structure and technical SEO, so the right people find you.

items.name: Social Media
items.text: Social media management for Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube: strategy, scripts, filming (depending on location), video editing and account management.

items.name: Graphic Design
items.text: Logo design and visual identity — the colours, fonts and style that make your brand instantly recognisable.

items.name: AI Photos & Videos
items.text: AI-generated photos and videos — striking images and short clips for posts, campaigns and ads.

items.name: Automation & AI Assistants
items.text: Auto-replies for Instagram and WhatsApp, AI chatbots and smart workflows that save you hours and answer clients around the clock.
